messages.businessImpact: Compliance is enforced for other platforms while Windows, which is this assessment's estate, can still reach the apps those policies cover without being compliant.
remediation: Include Windows in the device platform condition on each listed policy, or write a separate enabled policy that reaches Windows with Require compliant device.
messages.cannotSee: A policy that names no platform already includes Windows and will not raise. Report-only policies are CAD-002. Whether the policy covers company email and files is CAD-001's question.
